name: @milo-os/billing-provider-plugin
description: Billing's staff-portal plugin: a fleet-wide billing overview (money collected, outstanding and past due, aging, top accounts, collections, usage by service) as the Overview of /admin/service-catalog/billing-miloapis-com.

scripts.preinstall: node -e "const a=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!a.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Use pnpm to install this package (see package.json packageManager), not: '+(a.split(' ')[0]||'unknown'));process.exit(1)}"
